## Where we are {#where}

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"htmlLabels": false, "flowchart": {"htmlLabels": false}}}%%
flowchart LR
  L["dataset folder:<br/>SRR_Acc_List.txt<br/>SraRunTable.csv"] --> PF["prefetch"] --> V["vdb-validate"] --> FQ["fasterq-dump"] --> Z["compress"] --> C["check"] --> M["merge, rename"] --> P["pipeline"]
  L -. "or" .-> E["ENA .fastq.gz"] --> C
```

## Start in the dataset folder {#dataset-folder}

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jpflores-13/download-public-data.git ~/download-public-data   # once
cd ~/public_data/GSE52778          # has SRR_Acc_List.txt and SraRunTable.csv (deck 1)
mkdir -p sra tmp fastq logs
```

Every command in this deck runs **from here**; outputs land **here**.

## Setup {#setup}

```bash
# any Mac / Linux (Windows: inside WSL)
conda create -n sra -c conda-forge -c bioconda sra-tools pigz
conda activate sra
fasterq-dump --version            # want 3.x

# or, on a cluster
module avail sra
```

Test: `fastq-dump --stdout -X 2 SRR390728` prints 8 lines.

## Configure once {#configure}

```bash
vdb-config --prefetch-to-cwd                 # downloads go to the current folder
vdb-config -i                                # interactive settings
vdb-config --interactive-mode textual        # same, when -i won't open over ssh
```

- Home folders on clusters are small: **`cd` somewhere with space** first.
- SRA Lite vs Normalized: a checkbox in `vdb-config -i`.

## Where to run it {#where-to-run}

| | Laptop / workstation | Cluster |
|---|---|---|
| Good for | a few runs | many runs |
| Run in | a folder / external drive with space | **scratch** space |
| How | type commands, or a loop | batch jobs |
| Keep results in | backed-up storage | project / lab space |

## prefetch: download {#prefetch}

```bash
prefetch SRR1039508 --max-size u -O sra -p
ls sra/SRR1039508/        # SRR1039508.sra
```

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--max-size u` | No size limit (default: **20 GB**) |
| `-O sra` | Put it in `sra/` |
| `-p` | Progress bar |
| `--option-file list.txt` | Many accessions |

Interrupted? Run it again: it **resumes**.

## vdb-validate: check {#validate}

```bash
vdb-validate sra/SRR1039508
```

- `... is consistent` → good
- `error` / `corrupt` → delete the folder, `prefetch` again

Cheap check before an expensive conversion.

## fasterq-dump: convert {#fasterq-dump}

```bash
fasterq-dump sra/SRR1039508 --threads 6 --temp tmp --outdir fastq
pigz -p 6 fastq/SRR1039508*.fastq            # it doesn't compress for you
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--threads` / `-e` | 6 | match your CPUs |
| `--temp` / `-t` | here | **lots** of temp space |
| `--outdir` / `-O` | here | |
| split mode | `--split-3` | pairs → `_1`, `_2`; orphans → `.fastq` |

## Split-3: what files you get {#split-3}

| Spot has | Goes to |
|---|---|
| read 1 + read 2 | `SRR…_1.fastq` and `SRR…_2.fastq`, matching order |
| one read only | `SRR….fastq` (orphans) |

Paired pipeline → use `_1` and `_2`. Check the orphan file is **small**.

## Disk space {#disk-space}

- FASTQ ≈ **7×** the `.sra`
- temp ≈ **1.5×** the FASTQ again
- → plan for **10–20×** the `.sra` free while converting

```bash
df -h .                   # free space here
du -sh sra/SRR1039508     # size of the download
```

Not `/tmp` on a cluster node: often tiny.

## Three converters {#converters}

| | `fastq-dump` | `parallel-fastq-dump` | `fasterq-dump` |
|---|---|---|---|
| Speed | slow | faster | fastest |
| `--gzip` | yes | yes | no (use `pigz`) |
| Default split | **none** | none | `--split-3` |
| Temp space | little | some | **a lot** |

```bash
parallel-fastq-dump --sra-id sra/SRR1039508 --threads 4 --outdir fastq \
  --tmpdir tmp --split-3 --gzip
```

## ⚠ `--split-files` vs `--split-3` {#split-files}

Older scripts use `fastq-dump --split-files`.

- If some spots have **only one read**, those go into `_1` only
- → `_1` and `_2` have **different read counts**, pairs fall out of step
- → aligners pair the wrong reads

**Use `--split-3`**, and always compare `_1` vs `_2` read counts.

## Many runs: four routes {#many-runs}

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"htmlLabels": false, "flowchart": {"htmlLabels": false}}}%%
flowchart TD
  Q{"Where?"} -->|"any computer"| A["A: loop"]
  Q -->|"workstation"| B["B: xargs -P"]
  Q -->|"SLURM"| C["C: array job"]
  Q -->|"SLURM"| D["D: one job per run"]
  A & B & C & D --> S["prefetch → validate → convert → compress"]
  S --> F{"missing?"} -->|"yes"| R["resubmit failed.txt"] --> S
```

## Routes in one line each {#routes}

```bash
# A: loop (any computer)
while read -r a; do prefetch "$a" --max-size u -O sra && fasterq-dump "sra/$a" -e 4 -t tmp -O fastq \
  && pigz fastq/"$a"*.fastq && rm -rf "sra/$a"; done < SRR_Acc_List.txt

# C: SLURM array job, 4 at a time
sbatch --array=1-$(grep -c . SRR_Acc_List.txt)%4 ~/download-public-data/scripts/download_sra.sh SRR_Acc_List.txt fastq

# D: one SLURM job per run (fasterq-dump, or CONVERTER=parallel)
bash ~/download-public-data/scripts/submit_each.sh SRR_Acc_List.txt fastq
```

## Retry what failed {#retry}

Downloads **do** fail sometimes. Plan for it:

```bash
bash ~/download-public-data/scripts/find_missing.sh SRR_Acc_List.txt fastq > failed.txt   # what's missing or broken?
bash ~/download-public-data/scripts/submit_each.sh failed.txt fastq                        # resubmit just those
# repeat until failed.txt is empty
```

Checks the **files** (missing, corrupt `.gz`, `_1` ≠ `_2`), not log messages:
also catches jobs that were killed silently.

## Check what you got {#check}

```bash
for f in fastq/*.fastq.gz; do gzip -t "$f" || echo "BROKEN $f"; done      # complete?
for f in fastq/*.fastq.gz; do echo "$f $(( $(gzip -dc $f | wc -l) / 4 ))"; done   # counts
zcat fastq/SRR1039508_1.fastq.gz | head -8                               # looks right?
```

- `_1` count = `_2` count = the archive's **spots**
- Quality line all `?` → SRA Lite

## One sample, many runs → merge {#merge}

```bash
cat SRR111_1.fastq.gz SRR112_1.fastq.gz > sampleA_R1_001.fastq.gz
cat SRR111_2.fastq.gz SRR112_2.fastq.gz > sampleA_R2_001.fastq.gz
# or, from a run → sample table:
bash ~/download-public-data/scripts/merge_runs.sh runs_to_samples.tsv fastq merged
```

- `.gz` files concatenate safely
- R1 with R1, R2 with R2, **same order**
- Never merge different biological samples

## The ENA route {#ena}

```bash
bash ~/download-public-data/scripts/ena_download.sh PRJNA229998 fastq      # whole project, MD5-checked
```

| | SRA Toolkit | ENA |
|---|---|---|
| Software | prefetch + fasterq-dump | `curl` / `wget` |
| Temp space | 10–20× | none |
| Output | needs gzip | `.fastq.gz` |
| Check | `vdb-validate` | MD5 |

## Worked example: airway {#worked-example}

1. 8 runs (4 donors × untreated / Dex): `examples/airway_SRR_Acc_List.txt`
2. Download: ENA, a loop, or an array job
3. `merge_runs.sh` → `N61311_untrt_R1_001.fastq.gz`, …
4. Build a samplesheet (bagPipes, nf-core, …) from the run table
5. Keep `SraRunTable.csv`, read counts, toolkit version

## Special cases {#special-cases}

| Case | Do |
|---|---|
| 10x single-cell | `--split-files --include-technical` (barcode reads are "technical") |
| Uploaded as BAM | still converts; originals under *Data access* |
| "Paired" but one file | concatenated / interleaved upload: check read lengths |
| dbGaP | approved request first, then `--ngc key.ngc` |

## When things go wrong {#when-things-go-wrong}

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| `larger than maximum allowed` | `--max-size u` |
| `No space left on device` | `--temp` on a big disk |
| `Disk quota exceeded` (home) | `vdb-config --prefetch-to-cwd`, `cd` to scratch |
| hangs / timeouts | retry later; `prefetch` first; or ENA |
| `_1` ≠ `_2` counts | reconvert with `--split-3` |

## Cheat sheet {#cheat-sheet}

```bash
conda activate sra; vdb-config --prefetch-to-cwd
prefetch SRR... --max-size u -O sra
vdb-validate sra/SRR...
fasterq-dump sra/SRR... --threads 6 --temp tmp --outdir fastq
pigz -p 6 fastq/SRR...*.fastq
for f in fastq/*.gz; do echo "$f $(( $(gzip -dc $f | wc -l) / 4 ))"; done
bash ~/download-public-data/scripts/find_missing.sh SRR_Acc_List.txt fastq > failed.txt
bash ~/download-public-data/scripts/merge_runs.sh runs_to_samples.tsv fastq merged
```

## Recap {#recap}

1. **prefetch → vdb-validate → fasterq-dump → compress** (or ENA)
2. Plan **disk** (10–20×) and **retries**
3. **Check**: `_1` = `_2` = archive spots
4. **Organise**: merge runs, name by sample, keep the metadata
